name: 会話の通知と写真保存の設定群
prompt:
Refine the previous 390x188 Japanese three-row WhatsApp settings component. Keep its exact Japanese labels, values, original screenshot icons, colors, and restrained style, but correct the vertical proportions. Use a flat light-gray page background. Place a pure-white rounded card at x16 y28, width358 and height132, radius16. No border stroke or shadow. Leave light-gray margins above and below. Keep exactly two subtle separators between rows, beginning at x68 and ending at x374, at about y72 and y116; no bottom line.

Align the three row centers near y50, y94 and y138. Use a black outlined notification bell, an artist palette matching the original Chat theme screenshot, and a save-to-photos tray/arrow. Exact labels and values: 「通知」 / 「設定する」, 「会話の背景」 / 「設定する」, 「写真に保存」 / 「保存しない」. Labels are Meiryo Regular 14px/24px #1D1D1D; values are Meiryo Regular 12px/16px #6E6E6E; chevrons are small and light gray. Keep all text at its proper dark/gray role. These are action rows, not hyperlinks. The native text link metadata is null, so none of the text is blue; blue is reserved for actual hyperlinks per the user's request.

Use the original screenshot crop as the geometry and artwork authority and the native preview for the exact Japanese copy. Keep the original palette icon on the middle row even though the preview's placeholder is a photo icon. Do not add headers, extra rows, bottom separators, app chrome, shadows, gradients, or new copy. Preserve sharp, flat, accessible typography and the precise compact spacing.
reviewNotes: Candidate 2 keeps exact Japanese labels/values, source palette, dark labels, gray values/chevrons, and no blue text. It overcorrects the card size: after fitting to the 390x188 component canvas the card is about 25px too small in width and height versus the source; the generated aspect ratio is 2.70 instead of the target 2.07. Attempt 1 was about 17px too tall. Two-attempt limit reached; retain needs-correction.
